نستتبع (form X)
# نَسْتَتْبِعُ (nastatbiʕu) /nas.tat.bi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# نَسْتَتْبِعَ (nastatbiʕa) /nas.tat.bi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
# نَسْتَتْبِعْ (nastatbiʕ) /nas.tat.biʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَتْبَعَ (istatbaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
